reason: Recorded crimes rose from 37,944 in 2017 to 58,412 in 2018, in almost every group of crimes. At the time the Interior Ministry said that from 2018 it no longer left minor offences, such as damage to property, out of the figures. One sign in Geostat's own data: from 2018 each suicide is registered as an "incitement to suicide" investigation (Criminal Code article 115), which accounted for 1,119 of the 1,486 crimes against life in 2025 (December 2025 Unified Report on Criminal Justice Statistics, table 1-2, rows 2 and 12). The values before and after 2018 are therefore not comparable. How much of the rise is real is not known.
source_note: Geostat Number-of-Recorded-Crimes.xlsx (2017 and 2018 totals); Unified Report on Criminal Justice Statistics (Dec, 2025), table 1-2: https://geostat.ge/media/76844/Unified-Report-on-Criminal-Justice-Statistics-%28Dec%2C-2025%29.pdf. The Ministry's explanation is reported as the Ministry's: no official Ministry or Geostat text on the 2018 change was reachable when this package was built (see README)
